findings.detail: CHANGELOG.md describes a new Open Sales Program. Referrers earn 5% of referred consumers' collected token spend as withdrawable earnings funded by Darkbloom. Settlement is atomic per request, attribution is immutable, and uncertain settlements are retried. This adds a self-service reward-minting path into A-009, the payment ledger, and a new payout path for TB-008. The threat model has no threat for referral-code registration, self-referral or colluding accounts, duplicate or replayed settlement during retry and shutdown reconciliation, or exclusion of owner-routed spend. Only the changelog was visible here, so I could not verify the code. Add a threat entry covering these abuse cases (sybil or self-referral, settlement idempotency, Privy-session enforcement on mutations, owner and self-route exclusions). Add a concurrency and idempotency test for the retry path before relying on the stated mitigations.
findings.title: Referral reward ledger is a new financial surface not covered by the threat model
